shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log -5 --oneline && rg -n \"lastUsage|totalUsage|UsageMetadata|afterModelResponse\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts src/types/ai.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg --files scripts/spec-links package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,110p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,70p' CHANGELOG.md && command -v lore-query-trace || true"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').scripts, null, 2)\" && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "docs: describe aggregate turn usage"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
